description: Training-only exact-instruction tasks for collecting trajectories that address precise verifier wording without leaking held-out eval prompts.

tasks.prompt: In the release notes fixture, update the status line from pending to the exact text 'Status: ready for candidate review'. Make the smallest correct edit and return a final answer after the verifier condition is satisfied.
tasks.expected_artifact: RELEASE.md status says ready for candidate review
tasks.verifier: python3 -c "from pathlib import Path; text = Path('RELEASE.md').read_text(encoding='utf-8'); assert 'Status: ready for candidate review' in text; assert 'Status: pending' not in text"

tasks.prompt: In the collection policy fixture, update the mode line from relaxed to the exact text 'Mode: strict trajectory collection'. Make the smallest correct edit and return a final answer after the verifier condition is satisfied.
tasks.expected_artifact: POLICY.md mode says strict trajectory collection
tasks.verifier: python3 -c "from pathlib import Path; text = Path('POLICY.md').read_text(encoding='utf-8'); assert 'Mode: strict trajectory collection' in text; assert 'Mode: relaxed' not in text"
